title: LTE OFDM Modulator
text: Modulate LTE resource grid and return time-domain OFDM samples, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Rounding Method} sets Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations; {NDLRB source} sets the source of NDLRB, {NDLRB} sets the number of downlink resource blocks, {Cyclic prefix source} sets the source of cyclic, {Cyclic prefix type} sets the type of cyclic, {Windowing} sets the spectral growth reduction, {Window length per NDLRB} sets the nDRLB window length, {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal, {Output data sample rate} sets the output sample rate Use maximum output data sample and {Divide butterfly outputs by two} sets the bit-width control. Values come from the instance.

params.name: NDLRB source
params.values: Source of NDLRB Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Cyclic prefix source
params.values: Source of cyclic prefix Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Cyclic prefix type
params.values: Type of cyclic prefix Normal (default) | Extended

params.name: Window length per NDLRB
params.values: NDRLB window length [ 4, 6, 4, 6, 8, 8 ] (default) | row vector of NDLRB window lengths

params.name: Output data sample rate
params.values: Output sample rate Use maximum output data sample rate (default) | Match output data sample rate to NDLRB

params.name: Rounding Method
params.values: Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero
